# MBC-Pro Sensors (English)

> Competition-grade, plug-and-play sensors and expansion modules for LEGO SPIKE Prime, MINDSTORMS EV3, Pybricks, Arduino / ESP32 / Arduino R4, micro:bit, MATRIX Mini R4 and mBlock (mBot). Not for use in official FIRST® LEGO® League Challenge matches, which allow LEGO-made parts only.

The Chinese master file is https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/llms.txt ; the full knowledge base is https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/llms-full.txt .

## Products

- [Line Follower 8-ch (Line8)](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/line8/): 8-channel IR line array with noise rejection and auto-calibration.
- [Line Follower 16-ch (Line16)](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/line16/): 16-channel wide line array for crossings and high-speed turns.
- [ToF Ranger 2-ch (TOF2)](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/tof2/): dual time-of-flight laser rangefinder, cm and mm.
- [ToF Ranger 8-ch (TOF8)](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/tof8/): 8-point 180° laser array for obstacle avoidance.
- [Gamepad Receiver PS2](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/ps2/): 2.4G wireless gamepad receiver (Taiwan only).
- [Gamepad Receiver PS4/PS5](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/ps4/): Bluetooth PS4/PS5 controller receiver.
- [IMU 9-Axis Gyro](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/imu/): gyro + accelerometer + magnetometer, drift-free fused heading.
- [Sharpshooter Vision](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/unicam/) (in development, firmware v1 not yet hardware-verified): camera sensor, one camera with 4 menu-selected camera modes (color tracking up to 16 colors, color at points H/S/V, color order left to right, line following with near/middle/far offsets, angle and junction type); read on SPIKE (Pybricks library modes 9/6, Pybricks blocks modes 5/7, official app mode 0), EV3 (Infrared Sensor modes 0/1/2), MATRIX (mVision, 10 slots) and I2C 0x4C (Arduino, micro:bit); mBlock 5 (mBot / Ranger / Orion / MegaPi over RJ25 serial 38400, same value table as I2C, "Vision Universal" category of the MBC Pro Sensors extension v2.1.0, [mBlock guide](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/unicam/mblock/)). Slot-by-slot layout: [value reference](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/unicam/reference.html).
- [Sharpshooter Vision legacy editions (no longer supported)](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/esp32cam/): Sharpshooter ESP32CAM units shipped before 2026-10 (School edition, WRO edition HUE12) are no longer supported; guides and examples stay for reference. To upgrade to the current Sharpshooter Vision, send it back through the distributor you bought it from: the firmware update is free, the buyer pays shipping both ways.
- [SPIKE 6-Port Expander (EXP6)](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/exp6/): six extra motor/sensor ports for SPIKE Prime.
- [SPIKE 6-Port Servo Expander (Servo6)](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/servo6/): six servos on one SPIKE port (coming soon).

## Platforms & protocols

- [SPIKE / Robot Inventor / Pybricks](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/line8/spike-hub.html): official app blocks read mode 0, Pybricks reads mode 9 via MBC libraries.
- [MINDSTORMS EV3](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/sensors/line8/ev3-hub.html): EV3-G, EV3 Classroom, clev3r and Pybricks.
- [Universal I2C protocol v2](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/en/i2c-protocol.html): register number = value number, int16 little-endian, burst reads; shared F0–F5, F8 re-address, EF reboot.
<!-- gen:llms-platforms -->
- [Product × host value reference index](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/reference.html): how every value of every product is read on the six hosts (SPIKE, EV3, Arduino I2C, mBlock, MATRIX, micro:bit).
- [MBC universal I2C protocol v2](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/i2c-protocol.html): write an id, read int16 little-endian; shared F0~F5 version / status, F8 re-address, EF reboot.
- [mBlock 5 extension v2](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/makeblock.html): UART 38400, 3-byte replies with checksum, FD pack-all.
- [MATRIX Mini R4](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/matrix.html): stock 0x22 R~K mapping and the Sharpshooter mVision format.
- [micro:bit MakeCode](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/microbit.html): pxt-mbc-sensors extension v2.
- [Protocol plain text](https://mbc-pro-sensors.github.io/llms-protocol.txt): value tables, commands and status flags of every product.
<!-- /gen -->
